entity.description: A stop of a work center (facilityId) of an organization, from fromDate to thruDate (open while empty): no material, no operator, waiting for quality, a changeover or an equipment fault are reasons on the same interval model. The reason is an organization's ProductionReason code, and the stop keeps the classification of the row in effect at its start (category, equipment fault, planned stop). An equipment fault with an asset records or links the asset's one open outage (resourceUnavailabilityId, review Y3). The maintenance it asked for is an AssetMaintenance with an optional intake Request (D24). A correction never changes a row: it makes a new row (correctionOfDowntimeId, the first of the chain originalDowntimeId) that keeps the reporter and report date, and marks the row it corrects PdtCorrected with supersededByDowntimeId, so the original interval and actor stay readable. A stop longer than its reason's approval threshold (minutes, kept from the reason row at its start) needs a supervisor's approval once it has ended (approvalRequired; approvedByUserId and approvedDate when given). revision counts the changes of a row (close, approval, correction) for expectedRevision.

entity.description: A production reason code of an organization (design-manufacturing ReasonCodes): loss, downtime, hold and amendment reasons, each a dated row with its classification, audit-logged. A reason is active while a row is in effect; deactivating ends it and never deletes it, so the events that name the code keep it, and each event keeps the classification it was recorded with. Written by mantle.work.ProductionServices.store#ProductionReasons.

entity.description: One schedule change of a production operation (schedule#ProductionOperation): a move to a work center and dates, or an unschedule, applied or requested. A change with conflicts is applied only with a supervisor's override (overrideApplied Y, its reason kept); a scheduler without that authority requests it (SchRequested), and a supervisor applies or refuses the request. The work center's capacity is never changed by an override. The row keeps where the operation was and where it went, the conflicts found when it was applied or asked for, and who did what.

entity.description: An approved hourly cost policy is a dated row; money is independently guarded and audit-logged.

A dated capacity of a work center, for one product, a product type or every product (both empty): a quantity per duration (WccbRate: quantity in quantityUomId per perDuration of durationUomId) or a number of parallel slots (WccbSlots: operations that run at once). A row is not changed once written except to end it (thruDate); a new row for the same basis and product starting later ends the one in effect.

A dated alternate of a work center: another work center of the same organization that may take its operations, for one product or every product, in sequence order, with the capability or qualification it carries. Ended, never changed, once written.
